tutorial.title: Welcome to PartOn
tutorial.slide1Body: Apply to nearby shift jobs and get approved the same day.
tutorial.slide2Body: Post shifts for your branches, manage applicants, and track shift execution.
tutorial.slide3Body: Select your weekly availability hours. Confirm attendance 3 hours before the shift.
tutorial.slide4Body: Check-in requires GPS geofencing. Tokens are captured upon shift completion.
